dataset: Model-knowledge draft fill for missing standard points (CV/GV)
policy: Every record is draft / model_draft_pending_source_review. Conservative textbook-level content written by Claude from standard TCM education knowledge. Must be verified against WHO SAPL, CloudTCM, and professional textbooks before any promotion. Needling fields are study reference only, not operating instructions.

records.location_zh: 會陰部，男性當陰囊根部與肛門連線的中點；女性當大陰唇後聯合與肛門連線的中點。
records.location_en: In the perineum, at the midpoint between the anus and the root of the scrotum in males, or the posterior labial commissure in females.
functions_en: Revives consciousness, regulates the two lower orifices.
records.needling: 直刺 0.5-1 寸；部位私密敏感，須明確告知並取得同意後操作。
contraindications: 孕婦慎用；局部感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 下腹部，前正中線上，恥骨聯合上緣中點處。
records.location_en: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, at the midpoint of the superior border of the pubic symphysis.
functions_en: Warms the kidney, strengthens yang, regulates menstruation and discharge.
records.needling: 直刺 0.5-1 寸；針前排空膀胱。
contraindications: 孕婦禁針；膀胱充盈時不可深刺。
danger: Full bladder lies beneath — have the patient void before needling. Contraindicated in pregnancy.

records.location_zh: 下腹部，前正中線上，臍中下 4 寸。
records.location_en: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, 4 cun inferior to the center of the umbilicus.
functions_zh: 益腎興陽，通經止帶，利膀胱。膀胱之募穴。
functions_en: Benefits the kidney, regulates the uterus, promotes bladder function. Front-mu of the bladder.
records.needling: 直刺 0.5-1 寸；針前排空膀胱。
contraindications: 孕婦禁針；膀胱充盈時不可深刺。
danger: Void bladder first. Contraindicated in pregnancy.

records.location_zh: 下腹部，前正中線上，臍中下 2 寸。
records.location_en: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, 2 cun inferior to the center of the umbilicus.
functions_zh: 理氣止痛，通利水道。三焦之募穴。
functions_en: Regulates qi, relieves pain, frees the waterways. Front-mu of the triple burner.
contraindications: 孕婦禁針灸；古籍載婦人慎用之說需來源核對。
danger: Contraindicated in pregnancy. Classical caution for women pending source review.

records.location_zh: 下腹部，前正中線上，臍中下 1 寸。
records.location_en: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, 1 cun inferior to the center of the umbilicus.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation, secures discharge, promotes water metabolism.
contraindications: 孕婦慎用。

records.location_zh: 腹中部，臍中央。
records.location_en: In the center of the umbilicus.
functions_en: Warms yang, rescues collapse, secures desertion (moxibustion).
records.needling: 禁針；宜灸（常用隔鹽灸、隔薑灸）。
contraindications: 禁針。臍部感染或皮膚破損時禁灸。
danger: Needling is contraindicated at this point — moxibustion only.

records.location_zh: 上腹部，前正中線上，臍中上 1 寸。
records.location_en: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 1 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus.
functions_en: Regulates the waterways, moves qi, relieves pain.
records.needling: 直刺 0.5-1 寸；水病傳統多用灸。
contraindications: 孕婦慎用。

records.location_zh: 上腹部，前正中線上，臍中上 2 寸。
records.location_en: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 2 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus.
functions_en: Fortifies the spleen, harmonizes the stomach, downbears counterflow.
contraindications: 孕婦慎用。

records.location_zh: 上腹部，前正中線上，臍中上 3 寸。
records.location_en: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 3 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus.
functions_en: Harmonizes the stomach, fortifies the spleen, moves bowel qi.
contraindications: 孕婦慎用。

records.location_zh: 上腹部，前正中線上，臍中上 5 寸。
records.location_en: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 5 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus.
functions_en: Harmonizes the stomach, downbears counterflow, transforms phlegm.
contraindications: 孕婦慎用。

records.location_zh: 上腹部，前正中線上，臍中上 6 寸。
records.location_en: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 6 cun superior to the center of the umbilicus.
functions_zh: 安神寧心，寬胸止痛。心之募穴。
functions_en: Calms the spirit, unbinds the chest, relieves pain. Front-mu of the heart.
records.needling: 向下斜刺 0.3-0.6 寸；不可深刺、不可向上斜刺 — 深部為肝左葉與心包。
contraindications: 不可深刺；肝腫大者尤其危險。
danger: Left lobe of the liver and the heart region lie deep — shallow oblique insertion directed inferiorly only.

records.location_zh: 上腹部，前正中線上，胸劍結合部下 1 寸。
records.location_en: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 1 cun inferior to the xiphisternal junction.
functions_zh: 安心寧神，寬胸定喘。絡穴。
functions_en: Calms the heart and spirit, unbinds the chest. Luo-connecting point of the Conception Vessel.
records.needling: 向下斜刺 0.3-0.6 寸；不可深刺與向上刺。
contraindications: 深部為肝與心，不可深刺。
danger: Liver and heart region deep to the point — shallow, inferiorly-directed insertion only.

records.location_zh: 胸部，前正中線上，胸劍結合中點處（平第 5 肋間）。
records.location_en: On the chest, on the anterior midline, at the xiphisternal junction, level with the 5th intercostal space.
functions_en: Unbinds the chest, downbears counterflow.
contraindications: 胸骨面淺薄，不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 胸部，前正中線上，平第 3 肋間。
records.location_en: On the chest, on the anterior midline, level with the 3rd intercostal space.
functions_en: Unbinds the chest, relieves cough and wheezing.
contraindications: 胸骨面淺薄，不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 胸部，前正中線上，平第 2 肋間。
records.location_en: On the chest, on the anterior midline, level with the 2nd intercostal space.
functions_en: Unbinds the chest, regulates qi, relieves cough.
contraindications: 胸骨面淺薄，不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 胸部，前正中線上，平第 1 肋間。
records.location_en: On the chest, on the anterior midline, level with the 1st intercostal space.
functions_en: Unbinds the chest, benefits the lung, relieves cough.
contraindications: 胸骨面淺薄，不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 胸部，前正中線上，胸骨上窩中央下 1 寸。
records.location_en: On the chest, on the anterior midline, 1 cun inferior to the center of the suprasternal fossa.
functions_en: Unbinds the chest, benefits the lung and throat.
contraindications: 胸骨面淺薄，不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 頸前區，胸骨上窩中央，前正中線上。
records.location_en: In the anterior neck, at the center of the suprasternal fossa, on the anterior midline.
functions_zh: 宣通肺氣，消痰止咳，利咽開音。
functions_en: Diffuses lung qi, transforms phlegm, benefits the throat and voice.
records.needling: 高風險操作：先直刺 0.2 寸，再將針尖轉向下方，緊貼胸骨柄後緣、氣管前緣緩慢刺入 0.5-1 寸；不可偏斜、不可過深。初學者以淺刺或指壓替代。
contraindications: 深部為氣管、頭臂靜脈與主動脈弓；操作須由受訓臨床人員執行。
danger: Trachea, brachiocephalic vein, and aortic arch lie deep — advanced technique required; beginners should not needle deeply.

records.location_zh: 頸前區，喉結上方，舌骨上緣凹陷中，前正中線上。
records.location_en: In the anterior neck, superior to the laryngeal prominence, in the depression above the hyoid bone, on the anterior midline.
functions_en: Benefits the throat and tongue, reduces swelling.
records.needling: 向舌根方向斜刺 0.5-0.8 寸，不留針過深過久。
contraindications: 頸前部血管豐富，控制深度方向。

records.location_zh: 面部，頦唇溝正中凹陷處。
records.location_en: On the face, in the depression at the center of the mentolabial groove.
functions_en: Dispels wind, unblocks the channel, engenders fluids.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 會陰區，尾骨下方，尾骨端與肛門連線的中點處。
records.location_en: In the perineal region, inferior to the coccyx, at the midpoint between the tip of the coccyx and the anus.
functions_zh: 寧神鎮驚，通便消痔。絡穴。
functions_en: Calms the spirit, treats hemorrhoids and prolapse. Luo-connecting point of the Governing Vessel.
records.needling: 緊靠尾骨前面、與骶骨平行斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可刺穿直腸。
contraindications: 進針方向錯誤可能刺傷直腸，須嚴格控制角度；局部感染時避開。
danger: Rectum lies anterior — needle parallel to the sacrum, never perpendicular.

records.location_zh: 骶區，正對骶管裂孔，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the sacral region, at the sacral hiatus, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation, clears heat, dispels cold-damp.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸。
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 腰區，第 4 腰椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上（約平髂嵴）。
records.location_en: In the lumbar region, in the depression below the spinous process of L4, on the posterior midline, about level with the iliac crests.
functions_en: Dispels cold-damp, relaxes the sinews.
indications_en: Lower limb atrophy or painful obstruction
records.needling: 直刺或向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸。
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 腰區，第 2 腰椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the lumbar region, in the depression below the spinous process of L2, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Supplements the kidney, strengthens yang, banks up the origin.
records.needling: 直刺或向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；常配灸。
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 腰區，第 1 腰椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the lumbar region, in the depression below the spinous process of L1, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Assists yang, fortifies the spleen, regulates intestinal qi.
records.needling: 直刺或向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸。
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 背區，第 11 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of T11, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Fortifies the spleen, drains damp, calms the spirit.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 棘突間深部為椎管，不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 背區，第 10 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of T10, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Fortifies the spleen, drains damp, clears heat.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 背區，第 9 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of T9, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Calms the liver, extinguishes wind, relieves spasm.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 背區，第 7 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上（約平肩胛下角）。
records.location_en: In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of T7, on the posterior midline, about level with the inferior angles of the scapulae.
functions_en: Benefits the gallbladder, abates jaundice, unbinds the chest.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 背區，第 6 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of T6, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Clears heat, transforms damp, relieves cough.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 背區，第 5 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of T5, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Calms the heart and spirit, clears heat.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 上背區，第 3 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of T3, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Diffuses the lung, clears heat, calms the spirit.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 上背區，第 1 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，後正中線上。
records.location_en: In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of T1, on the posterior midline.
functions_en: Releases the exterior, clears heat, interrupts malaria.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可深刺。
contraindications: 不可深刺。

records.location_zh: 頸後區，後髮際正中直上 0.5 寸，第 2 頸椎棘突上際凹陷中。
records.location_en: In the posterior neck, 0.5 cun superior to the midpoint of the posterior hairline, in the depression above the spinous process of C2.
functions_en: Opens the voice, revives consciousness.
records.needling: 高風險操作：正坐位頭微前傾，向下頜方向緩慢刺入 0.5-1 寸；嚴禁向上深刺 — 深部為延髓。傳統列為禁灸穴。
contraindications: 深部為延髓，方向錯誤或過深可致命；須由受訓臨床人員操作；傳統禁灸。
danger: Medulla oblongata lies deep — needle slowly toward the mandible, never upward or deep. Potentially fatal if misdirected.

records.location_zh: 頸後區，後髮際正中直上 1 寸，枕外隆凸直下，兩側斜方肌之間凹陷中。
records.location_en: In the posterior neck, 1 cun superior to the midpoint of the posterior hairline, directly below the external occipital protuberance, in the depression between the trapezius muscles.
functions_en: Dispels and extinguishes wind, opens the portals.
records.needling: 高風險操作：正坐位頭微前傾，向下頜方向緩慢刺入 0.5-1 寸；嚴禁向上深刺 — 深部為延髓。
contraindications: 深部為延髓，操作規範同啞門；須由受訓臨床人員執行。
danger: Medulla oblongata lies deep — same precautions as GV15.

records.location_zh: 頭部，枕外隆凸上緣凹陷中（風府直上 1.5 寸）。
records.location_en: On the head, in the depression at the superior border of the external occipital protuberance, 1.5 cun superior to GV16.
functions_en: Revives the spirit, calms the liver, extinguishes wind.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 頭部，後髮際正中直上 4 寸（腦戶上 1.5 寸）。
records.location_en: On the head, 4 cun superior to the midpoint of the posterior hairline, 1.5 cun superior to GV17.
functions_en: Calms the spirit, extinguishes wind.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 頭部，百會（GV20）後 1.5 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, 1.5 cun posterior to GV20 Baihui.
functions_en: Calms the spirit, extinguishes wind.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 頭部，百會（GV20）前 1.5 寸（前髮際正中直上 3.5 寸）。
records.location_en: On the head, 1.5 cun anterior to GV20, 3.5 cun superior to the midpoint of the anterior hairline.
functions_en: Extinguishes wind, arouses the brain, calms the spirit.
records.needling: 平刺 0.3-0.5 寸；嬰幼兒囟門未閉者禁刺。
contraindications: 嬰幼兒囟門未閉禁刺。

records.location_zh: 頭部，前髮際正中直上 2 寸（百會前 3 寸）。
records.location_en: On the head, 2 cun superior to the midpoint of the anterior hairline, 3 cun anterior to GV20.
functions_en: Calms the spirit, clears heat, reduces swelling.
records.needling: 平刺 0.3-0.5 寸；嬰幼兒囟門未閉者禁刺。
contraindications: 嬰幼兒囟門未閉禁刺。

records.location_zh: 頭部，前髮際正中直上 1 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, 1 cun superior to the midpoint of the anterior hairline.
functions_en: Extinguishes wind, clears heat, frees the nose.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 頭部，前髮際正中直上 0.5 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, 0.5 cun superior to the midpoint of the anterior hairline.
functions_en: Calms the spirit, arouses the brain.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 面部，鼻尖正中央。
records.location_en: On the face, at the center of the tip of the nose.
functions_zh: 清熱消腫，通利鼻竅，回陽救逆。
functions_en: Clears heat, frees the nose, rescues yang (resuscitation).
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.3-0.5 寸，或點刺出血；不灸。
contraindications: 傳統不灸；局部感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 面部，上唇結節的中點（上唇尖端，皮膚與唇紅移行處）。
records.location_en: On the face, at the midpoint of the tubercle of the upper lip, at the vermilion border.
functions_en: Calms the spirit, engenders fluids.
contraindications: 局部感染時避開。

records.location_zh: 口腔內，上唇繫帶與上齒齦的相接處。
records.location_en: Inside the mouth, at the junction of the frenulum of the upper lip and the upper gum.
functions_en: Calms the spirit, clears heat, reduces swelling.
records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.2-0.3 寸，或點刺出血。
contraindications: 口腔衛生不良或局部感染時避開。
